postal_system.current_code_name: Mongolia postal codes: five-digit base and version-qualified extended assignments
postal_system.legal_rule: The dated CRC 2025 explanation cites MNS 6775:2024 and a five-digit national code. Another live CRC page mixes a different 2025 count with the 2019 explanation: a five-digit postal zone and a nine-digit unified code that appends four digits and is assigned to a building. The 2024 directory also prints an extended organization example, so nine-digit syntax is retained without asserting repeal or current nationwide assignment. These references are not current validated rows, canonical polygons, building geometry or redistribution permission.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Store the five-digit zone as a five-character string and the nine-digit unified code canonically as NNNNN-NNNN, preserving leading zeroes. Production assignment requires an exact current CRC result with code kind, authority, validity, retrieval time, response schema and digest pinned. Prefix structure, administrative codes, coordinates, map labels, Gazar grid codes, post-office points, boundary overlap and nearest features do not create a postal assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Mongolia postcode polygon artifact is bundled. An official five-digit postal surface requires an exact postal-authority geometry artifact and code relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. Joining an exact five-digit assignment to a permitted administrative boundary remains a derived postal-zone surface with uncertainty. A nine-digit code is a building assignment identifier and is non-spatial unless an explicit rights-cleared provider relation supplies permitted building geometry. Gazar grids, Voronoi, interpolation, OSM and models never become official postal polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organization, apartment or unit, building, premise or door number, street, bag or khoroo, soum or district, aimag or capital and postal code remain typed and validity-aware. Rural, P.O. Box and urban patterns differ. A five-digit zone, nine-digit code, coordinate, administrative code, Gazar grid or map label alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit, exact legal civic address or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.building_rule: A nine-digit unified code may reach building display only through the exact CRC or rights-cleared provider record, an explicit stable building identifier or reviewed crosswalk, and separately permitted building geometry. Exact rights, purpose, validity, privacy, CRS and digests are mandatory. Five-digit containment, code suffix similarity, Gazar-grid containment, cadastral overlap, coordinate equality, name match, proximity and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only.
postal_system.grid_rule: The government coordinate-based address system describes 100 km, 10 km and 10 m grids. Those grid identifiers remain Gazar address-grid context and are never treated as CRC postal codes or AGID cells. AGID is an independent spatial index and may link through an explicit versioned crosswalk without relabelling either system.
postal_system.licence_rule: CRC, UPU, Gazar, NSDI and NSO pages are reference evidence until exact item-specific reuse terms are recorded. Public search, map, viewer or service access, regulator authority, an open-data programme and a standard do not by themselves grant blanket row, layer, address, cadastral or building redistribution rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, code and address queries, phones, emails, identities, households, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, land or parcel rights, cadastral records, access credentials, tracking records and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.
postal_system.edition_rule: Keep the 2024 directory, dated 2025 CRC explanation, mixed-version live CRC page and UPU 01/2019 distinct. Report the 2721 versus 2720 count conflict; do not silently choose a national coverage denominator. An accepted five- or nine-digit string is compatibility syntax, never proof of current assignment. Pin exact effective dates and provider relations before building display.

stages.definition: Reference metadata and synthetic runtime only; no production source release.

Current rights-cleared CRC Mongolia assignments with edition-specific five-digit and explicitly attested extended-code semantics, stable string identifiers, leading zeroes, Cyrillic names, validity, acquisition time, schema and SHA-256. Reconcile contradictory official counts and 2019/2024 standard descriptions without deleting legacy identifiers or treating syntax as assignment. Exact permitted geometry needs an explicit temporal postal relation, reviewed CRS, scale and topology; keep official/derived/virtual/none separate and no surface if absent. Independently permitted civic/building relations are mandatory for house numbers or buildings. Gazar grids, NSO administrative statistics and AGID remain separate namespaces. Real-record coverage, exceptions, privacy, reproducible transforms, rights snapshots, approved immutable digest-pinned data artifacts and the actual AGID loader/API must all pass.
